02

vote now!

before you listen
🏫 In American high schools, every student gets a yearbook — a big book with photos from the school year. Students vote for the Class Awards. This year Brittany and Mandy are on the yearbook team! 📸

Look at the board. Who are the nominees for each award?
📕 yearbook
a book with photos of the school year
🗳️ vote (for)
choose a person: "I vote for Jake!"
⭐ nominee
a person who can win the award
🥇 winner
the person who gets the award

Step 1 · Guess! Who wins? Tick ✓ one nominee and say why.  Step 2 · Listen (Task 1) and write the winner.

award 🏆nominees🎧 the winner is...
😂 the funniestAlex Tyler
🎨 the most creativeBobby Leo
📚 the most hard-workingJake Mandy
🏉 the sportiestBrittany Chloe

💬 Say: I think Tyler is the funniest because he ...  ·  Maybe Mandy is more hard-working than Jake.

words from the listening

before you listen

You will hear these words. Match them with the meanings. Write the letter.

1  grades"My grades are better in Maths."
2  a back flip"Can you do a back flip?"
3  a planner"She has a planner for everything!"
4  the results"And now... the results!"
5  close"Bobby was very close!"
6  congratulations"Congratulations, Chloe!"
a  🤸 you jump and turn over backwards in the air
b  📝 the marks you get at school: A, B, C...
c  🎉 what you say to a winner
d  📒 a notebook for your plans and homework
e  🏆 the final answers: who wins?
f  🤏 almost the same, almost the winner

04

louder, better, the best

grammar

Look at Task 3 again. We compare two people → than. We compare three or more people → the.

vs
2 people 👥
Tyler is louder than Alex.
3+ people 👥👥
Tyler is the loudest boy in the school.
adjective
2 people · ... than
3+ people · the ...
more words like this
short
1 syllable · +er / +est
loud → louder than
calm → calmer than
the loudest
the calmest
kind, quiet, strict, shy
nice → nicer · big → bigger ✌️
ends in -y
y → ier / iest
funny → funnier than
lazy → lazier than
the funniest
the laziest
sporty, bossy, friendly
long
2+ syllables · more / the most
more creative than
more patient than
the most creative
the most patient
outgoing, helpful, hard-working, easy-going
irregular ⚠️
good → better than
bad → worse than
the best
the worst
learn them by heart! 🧠
🚫 Alex's typical mistakes
❌ more funny  → ✅ funnier
❌ the most loud  → ✅ the loudest
❌ funnier that me  → ✅ funnier than me
❌ gooder / the goodest  → ✅ better / the best
💡 Useful phrases
the funniest in our class / in my family
the most creative person I know
much louder than me 🔊
a bit quieter than my brother 🔉

Quick check · Which rule? Write the adjectives in the right box.

calmlazypatientkindsportyhelpfulquietcreativebossyoutgoingstrictfriendly
➕ -er / -est
loud → louder
✂️ y → -ier / -iest
funny → funnier
📏 more / the most
creative → more creative
